_comment: NTHU campus vendors and menus (Fengyun Hall, Shuimu Center, Snack Bar), collected 2026-11-18 from public Google Maps listings: a menu-board photo for 珈名鮮茶 (2026-03) and reviews that list dishes with prices. Prices change; check at the counter. Vendor descriptions were written by us. Images are original illustrations in frontend/img/, not photos of the real food. Items name their vendor by vendor name_zh. This file is what the database is seeded with; the app reads menus from the database. frontend/js/mock/data.js is a separate copy used only for the first-login tutorial and for opening the frontend without a backend.

vendors.description_zh: 丼飯與炸物定食。在點餐機點餐、看螢幕叫號取餐，套餐附小菜；醬料、辣粉與胡椒自取。
vendors.description_en: Rice bowls and fried cutlet sets. Order at the kiosk and pick up when your number shows on the screen; sets come with small sides, and sauces are self-serve.

vendors.description_zh: 炭烤便當。雞腿、雞排、雞柳先炸後烤再刷醬，附白飯與配菜。
vendors.description_en: Charcoal-grilled bento. Chicken leg, cutlet and strips are fried, then grilled and brushed with sauce; served with rice and sides.

vendors.description_zh: 現點現炒的炒飯與炒麵，粒粒分明，不定期推出限定口味。
vendors.description_en: Fried rice and stir-fried noodles cooked to order, with limited-time specials now and then.

vendors.description_zh: 日式丼飯與拉麵。丼飯配高麗菜、玉米，可加起司或加飯；另有平價的校園特餐。
vendors.description_en: Japanese rice bowls and ramen. Bowls come with cabbage and corn, with cheese or extra rice on request; there is also a budget campus special.

vendors.description_zh: 小吃部裡的手搖飲與現打果汁：現泡茶、風味茶、拿鐵和新鮮果汁，茶飲可加珍珠、椰果、布丁或仙草凍。
vendors.description_en: Hand-shaken tea and fresh juice in XCB: brewed teas, flavoured teas, lattes and fresh fruit juice, with pearls, coconut jelly, pudding or grass jelly on top.

vendors.description_zh: 小吃部的牛肉麵店。乾拌麵帶沙茶香、微辣，麵條偏粗有嚼勁；單點燙青菜份量大。
vendors.description_en: Beef noodle stall in XCB. The dry noodles have a satay-sauce kick and thick, chewy noodles; the side of greens is generous.
